privacyPage.title: Card Barcodes Privacy Policy
privacyPage.description: What Card Barcodes does with your cards, your location and the camera, and what leaves your device.

packages.rsbarcodes_swift: an open-source library that draws barcodes, entirely on your device

download.comment: The App Store button, in the words of Apple's Download on the App Store badge in each language.
download.ja: App Storeからダウンロード

screenshots.comment: Heading for the App Store images, read only by screen readers.

screenshotAlt.comment: An App Store image's description for screen readers, made of its caption's title and subtitle as two sentences.

features.comment: Heading over the sections of the App Store description.

languages.comment: Heading over the list of the languages the app is in.

languagesIntro.comment: Under the Languages heading: which of the languages the app shows.
languagesIntro.en: The app follows the language of your iPhone or iPad when it is one of these, and is in British English otherwise.
languagesIntro.es: La app usa el idioma de tu iPhone o iPad si es uno de estos y, si no, el inglés británico.
languagesIntro.de: Die App verwendet die Sprache deines iPhone oder iPad, wenn sie dabei ist, und sonst britisches Englisch.
languagesIntro.ja: iPhoneやiPadの言語がこの中にあればその言語で、なければイギリス英語で表示されます。

language.comment: What screen readers call the row of links to the site in each language.

earlierVersions.comment: Opens the list of every version before the current one, under What's New.

getApp.comment: Heading of the last section, with the App Store button.

requirements.comment: The devices the app runs on. {version} is the oldest iOS it runs on, such as 18.
requirements.en: For iPhone and iPad with iOS {version} or later.
requirements.es: Para iPhone y iPad con iOS {version} o posterior.
requirements.de: Für iPhone und iPad mit iOS {version} oder neuer.
requirements.ja: iOS {version}以降のiPhoneとiPadに対応しています。

privacy.comment: Link at the top of every page to the privacy policy, which is in English.

privacyPolicy.comment: Link at the foot of every page to the privacy policy, which is in English.
privacyPolicy.ja: プライバシーポリシー

contact.comment: Link at the foot of every page that writes an email to the developer.

consent.comment: The banner at the foot of the website asking to count the visit with Google Analytics, which uses cookies. Google Analytics is Google's product; keep its name. The app is Card Barcodes itself, which never tracks anyone.
consent.en: Can this website count your visit with Google Analytics? It uses cookies to do so. The app itself never tracks you.
consent.es: ¿Puede esta web contar tu visita con Google Analytics? Para ello usa cookies. La app nunca te rastrea.
consent.de: Darf diese Website deinen Besuch mit Google Analytics zählen? Dafür verwendet sie Cookies. Die App selbst verfolgt dich nie.
consent.ja: このウェブサイトで、Google アナリティクスを使って訪問を記録してもよいですか？記録には Cookie を使います。アプリ自体があなたを追跡することはありません。

consentAccept.comment: Button in the website's analytics banner that allows Google Analytics.

consentDecline.comment: Button in the website's analytics banner that turns Google Analytics down.

cookieSettings.comment: Link at the foot of every page that opens the analytics banner again, to change the choice.
